notes: GPS first-touch permission repair: Check My Location now makes the geolocation request before map/status DOM work so iOS can treat it as a direct user action.
summary: Check My Location uses a first-touch geolocation request; GPS remains optional and activity logs still save when GPS is not captured.
label: GpsFirstTouchPermissionRepair
whatsNew: Check My Location now sends the browser geolocation request as the first action after the tap.
Map/status updates happen only after the first-touch request succeeds or fails.
Activity logging remains valid and saveable even when GPS is not captured.
fixes: Removes map reset/map initialization/status DOM work before the Check My Location geolocation request.
Keeps the Location Status test focused on direct current-position proof for iOS permission behavior.
Keeps GPS route/distance additive rather than required for a valid activity log.
